policy.core_rule: The core desktop must install, start, and be usable with the required host stack only. An optional service is never a hard Requires/Depends.

markers.Recommends: Most users want it and the feature is first-party or strongly expected; the absence path still exists.
markers.Suggests: Useful when the host already provides it; no first-party feature depends on it.

policy.gpl_rule: GPL/LGPL services stay separate processes or dynamically linked libraries with notices. No GPL code is copied into MIT files and no GPL library is statically linked.
policy.verification: Package names and licenses are verified against the actual distro package at packaging time (T259). A missing optional service degrades the feature; it never blocks the session.

display_managers.decision: support all four session entries through the per-DM adapter; recommend GDM as the reference and SDDM as the secondary tested path
display_managers.packaging_marker: none: the desktop ships a session .desktop file and does not depend on a specific display manager
display_managers.absence: An ambiguous or unknown display manager degrades to the greeter (ADR 0173).
